basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old freelance graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. Passionate about sustainable living and minimalism. Enjoys experimenting with smart home technology and DIY home improvement projects. Recently moved into an older apartment, which inspired an interest in maintaining a fresh and healthy indoor environment. Typically online during late evenings and weekends. In a long-term relationship with a fellow designer who shares an interest in eco-friendly practices.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a strong foundation in design principles and is self-taught in smart home technologies. Actively learns through online courses and community forums. Has recently picked up interest in sustainable living practices through podcasts and YouTube channels.
